newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - July 30.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Labour Ministry says it has not set a quota for the number of nationals the private sector in the UAE should employ.
- High summer temperatures force livestock traders in the Gulf to stop ferrying animals by sea and move them instead by air at higher cost.
- Abu Dhabi municipality plans new projects worth 350 million dirhams to improve road network.
- Twelve recycling units to open in Dubai as part of drive to cut annual per capita waste to 555 kg in the next four years.
- Traders say decline in the value of the German mark against the dirham will only have a long-term effect on prices of goods imported into the UAE from Germany.
- Jebel Ali Free Zone imports in 1996 rise to $3.18 billion compared to $3.10 billion the previous year.
